name: @canvist/collab
description: canvist documents as Yjs peers with no DOM: join shared state, merge updates, and serve y-websocket's sync protocol, with typed commands, for Node, Deno, Bun, and Workers.

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm:document && npm run build:wasm:full
scripts.build:wasm:document: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_headless_wasm --target web --profile wasm-release --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-collab/wasm --out-name canvist_collab --no-pack -- --features collab && rm packages/canvist-collab/wasm/.gitignore
scripts.build:wasm:full: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/canvist_headless_wasm --target web --profile wasm-release --out-dir ../../packages/canvist-collab/wasm-full --out-name canvist_collab_full --no-pack -- --features full,collab && rm packages/canvist-collab/wasm-full/.gitignore
